title: GTA 6: 1 Din Mein Bharat Ke Saal Bhar Ke Cinema Se Zyada? #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 ne pehle din $3.79 billion ki bikri ki, India ke poore 2025 box office ka dhaai guna. Par Take-Two ki apni press release kehti hai ye "retail sales" hai, company ki kamai nahi.

- Take-Two / Rockstar press release, 20 Nov 2026: https://ir.take2games.com/node/32701/pdf (also SEC 8-K)

- Ormax Box Office Report 2025: https://www.ormaxmedia.com/stories/the-ormax-box-office-report-2025.html
- RBI reference rate, 20 Nov 2026: https://www.rbi.org.in/
